summary: install/list/trust/update/remove/sync plugin packs (untrusted until you trust them)
usage: plainkeep plugin add <owner/repo|path>[@tag] --yes | list | trust <name> --yes | update <name> --yes | remove <name> --yes | sync [<name>] --yes
hints: Installs a pack under plugins/<name>/, but its verbs are capped at confirm until `plainkeep plugin trust <name> --yes` — self-declared risk never takes effect at install. add/update/remove/trust need --yes; list is read-only. Common mistake: expecting a freshly added pack to run at its declared risk.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: installed packs + trust state (the default action)

actions.name: add
actions.summary: install a pack (capped at confirm until trusted); needs --yes

actions.name: trust
actions.summary: let a pack's verbs run at their declared risk; needs --yes

actions.name: sync
actions.summary: install packs' declared dependencies into <vault>/.plugin-deps/; needs --yes. Only the lockfile's declarations reach pip — there is no pass-through for arbitrary pip arguments

args.name: name
args.help: one pack, or every pack when omitted

args.name: --no-index
args.help: forbid pip any network index (offline install from --find-links)

args.name: --find-links
args.help: a local directory of wheels to install from; a URL is refused
